StartUtc.description: Start date of the restriction time interval, specified in ISO 8601 format and adjusted to UTC - see [Datetimes](https://mews-systems.gitbook.io/connector-api/guidelines/serialization#datetimes) for important information on format and implementation.

EndUtc.description: End date of the restriction time interval, specified in ISO 8601 format and adjusted to UTC - see [Datetimes](https://mews-systems.gitbook.io/connector-api/guidelines/serialization#datetimes) for important information on format and implementation.
